show-fuel-strip: Show the rulebook fuel strip with Dry / Wet chits at the hovered or pinned endpoint's final state. Toggle off to hide the panel entirely.
allow-jettison: Allow planner to drop fuel mid-route to improve thrust. May cause finding routes to take longer.
dry-mass: Ship mass without fuel, on the HF4A Wet-Mass strip (1–23). Higher total mass causes smaller thrust. You can also drag the red Dry chit on the fuel strip in the upper-left to set this visually.
fuel: Fuel-strip step distance from Dry to Wet chit. Three ways to set: (1) type a plain integer (5 = 5 fuel steps); (2) type fractional notation (1+5/6 = 1 mass + 5/6 of the way into the next interval); (3) drag the blue Wet chit on the fuel strip in the upper-left.
filter-mode: ANY-OF: match sites with at least one selected modifier. ALL-OF: match only sites that have every selected modifier.
engine.base-thrust: Engine thrust per burn before adjustments.
engine.fuel: Fuel steps this engine consumes per burn. Most engines are 1–2; high-thrust engines cost more.
engine.pivots: Lets you turn at non-Lagrange nodes without ending the turn or performing double burn.
engine.solar: Solar-powered engine: thrust scales with distance from the Sun.
engine.afterburn: Once per movement: spend fuel to gain net thrust.
engine.ab-cost: Fuel steps spent per afterburn use.
engine.mag-sail: Mag Sail thruster: each radiation belt entered grants Bonus Burns equal to the belt's severity, once per belt per movement.
engine.aerobrake-decom: Sail card: engine is destroyed (permanently non-operational) on entering an Aerobrake Hazard.
solar.cycle: HF4A Sol Sunspot Cycle (1–12). Click a spot to set the STARTING year of the mission. The highlight then follows the currently hovered/pinned endpoint — turn 1 sits at the starting year, each subsequent turn advances one spot clockwise. The starting spot keeps a small white dot when it isn't the currently displayed year. Seasons are red / yellow / blue, four years each. (Currently informational — the planner doesn't yet apply season effects.)
